rubrics.justification: Provides a plausible blastocyst-stage assessment with reasonable comments on ICM/TE and zona thinning, but the grading range is somewhat broad and includes features that may be over-interpreted from a single image.
Strongly integrates age, ovarian response, tubal factor diagnosis, prior IVF failures/miscarriages, sperm parameters, BMI, smoking, and especially the very thin endometrium into prognosis.

Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, linking fair embryo quality with major uterine/endometrial concerns; however, some quantitative penalty estimates are heuristic rather than firmly derived.

Core points such as concern over 5 mm endometrium and recommending further uterine evaluation are aligned, but several suggested tests/treatments (ERA, NK/cytokine testing, intralipids, routine PGT-A at age 26, G-CSF/PRP) are not strongly guideline-supported.

Gives clear next-step recommendations for transfer deferral, uterine evaluation, lifestyle modification, and future FET planning, though some proposed interventions are more speculative than standard.
